### Required migration and limitations

Each authorization-claim is intentionally retained for canonical visible
migration. A contract heading naming a decision is not a decision-entry
structural header. A correct broad quote cannot hide a more specific unsupported
scope or guarantee in its current surrounding prose.

- D-040 What supports hybrid traversal, form replay, incremental signature
  skipping, change tracking, T-170 response adoption and T-171 control coverage/
  destructive-last. It does not contain the attributed <=10% acceptance figure,
  (a)/(b)/(c) exact oracles, dual-check mandate, or first-PASS activation. Claims
  in crawl-traversal about those details remain specifically unavailable.
  D-040 asking for <=10% therefore is not a clean What-backed authority for
  coarse subtree pruning. D-023 What requires BFS/frontier coverage but does
  not explicitly contain the cited single-happy-path-DFS rejection text.
- explore's D-016 claims that concrete Obliterate behavior is accepted go
  beyond its What destructive-name matrix. D-015 What rejects vision-guided
  action choice; synthetic form filling prohibition is sourced to D-016/X10,
  not an explicit D-015 What ban. Later X13-X18 amendments name D-015 generic
  original-stage authorization or Changes-authorized-only specificity; retain
  exact claimed scope limitations instead of using its generic stage quote.
  D-029 narrow dev-only synthetic exception does have a What subject, and its
  checker-only contract-authoring restriction must survive attribution.
- crawl-traversal :359 D-031 future-healer scope is outside What, which
  corrects unsupported execution-architecture claims. network-assertions'
  D-032 observer-derived deferral quote is likewise outside bounded What.
- permission-surface's D-018 tier-switch association is wrong-What attribution:
  D-018 governs consent artifacts; switch wording is D-016 Why. D-054 What
  authorizes listed draft contracts, not every attributed caveat. PS4 explicitly
  disclaims D-040 origin and is independently nonclaiming on that occurrence.
  The first and second D-054 on :97 have DIFFERENT roles and kinds.
- release-regression's D-041 What starts LangGraph at T-167, but exact
  OR2/OR4-preservation, interrupt-never-replaces-RunApproval, trusted-baseline
  mechanics and pyproject timing wording are not all verbatim What. D-054
  What names RR1-RR5; RR6 stitching is not proved by selecting a generic
  drafting quote. D-055 What DOES explicitly state T-166/T-110-only dependencies.
  D-042 composition quote here is disclosed historical tension, not adopted
  lead-agent dependency authority; corresponding ordinary rows say so.
- skills' two-leftover-filename exclusion under D-041 is outside its What
  general SKILL.md mandate. UI :524 D-024 mandatory checker Mode D/browser
  PASS duty is outside its What intake definition; UI :468 D-025 atomic
  intake supports only its actual scope, not silently all added key ownership/
  re-onboarding detail. D-017 name-not-choose boundary applies to check choice,
  not new authority to alter stored source text.
- Supported narrower What subjects include D-048 advisory/video/process
  answers, D-049 baseline/blind-set clarification, D-050 video-link exception
  and named contract drafting, D-045 report failure details, D-035 source-adapter
  draft-to-ACTIVE adoption, and D-041 trace/parallel execution scope. These
  still require honest canonical migration; classification is not PASS.

Ordinary rows are individually justified links, historical checker findings,
disclosed contradiction records, fixture provenance or precedent analogies.
They cannot exempt adjacent authority claims. Changed text/multiplicity
invalidates review. Remaining contracts including AI/adversarial/agent layers,
eval-compiler/damage-control/failure-bundle/script-replay remain unreviewed
by checkpoint A/B and require further independent inventory work.

{"path":"docs/DECISIONS.md","line_text":"**Why:** AT-106, found by the checker on the D-019 unit.
